data.other_hard: at least 5 semesters of standard study time (Regelstudienzeit) remaining until the BAföG maximum funding period ends at the time of application; Sprachniveau B2 required for applicants who are not Bildungsinländer*innen
data.notes: Page is a general overview of ELES Studienwerk's scholarship application (name is generic 'ÜBERBLICK'); no nationality rule, GPA, deadline, field, funding amount or host country is stated. Applications for a master's from outside the EU must be specially justified in the motivation letter (requirement wording, not a rule set out in full). Bachelor students' 4-semester master phase counts toward the remaining study time. Applicant status is inferred from 'Möglich sind Bewerbungen vor Beginn eines Master-Studiums'. Page text is in German.
